_comment: Quality and infrastructure are INDEPENDENT states, per CTO ruling 31 Aug 2026. A model must not lose the quality ranking because one VPS cannot run it, and must not be promoted because it is cheap.

madlad.infrastructureNote: 21188 MB peak on a 23 GB box that also runs production; Yoruba p95 34.4 s. If human review makes it a route's quality winner, mark QUALITY QUALIFIED / INFRASTRUCTURE BLOCKED and leave optimisation to a separate decision. No quantisation/ONNX/GPU work authorised.

translategemma.note: The licence was never the problem -- Gemma permits commercial hosted use. Devanagari is the dominant intrusion in Yoruba (Cyrillic and Gujarati also appear); Hausa returns Arabic; Igbo produced ONE correctly-scripted output of three, plus an Arabic/Thai mix and a 75 s repetition loop. Controls fr/es/pt AND Swahili were correct in the same run, ruling out the harness.
translategemma.exclusionScope: Excluded for C7 Hausa, Igbo, Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin translation using the tested official TranslateGemma chat-template path and exact benchmark configuration (revision 10042cb0, transformers 5.16.1, torch 2.13.0+cpu, greedy decoding, float32 CPU). NOT a claim that the model can never translate these languages under other prompts, decoding strategies, precisions or future revisions.

toucan.note: Commercial licence enquiry SENT by the founder to the three UBC-NLP authors listed in the published ACL paper. Silence is not permission.

routes._comment: No route is promoted. Recommendations are candidates for human review only.
routes.humanReviewStatus: V2 forward packs are FINAL; TranslateGemma entered the top two for no direction so no V3 is required. ORDERING IS BINDING, per language: native-source elicitation -> contributor licence accepted -> corpus frozen with sha256 -> ONLY THEN send that reviewer V2. V2 must never precede elicitation for a given reviewer. Reverse directions remain UNMEASURED.
